responsibilities.fileserver: Own immutable file and reception facts; authorize access and confirm manifests.
responsibilities.media-worker: Own processing jobs, retries and derived output submission through HTTP APIs.
responsibilities.business: Authorize users and tenants, initiate processing and associate result files with business records.

compatibility: Component versions need not match. Both must support the same reception contract; consumers require worker schemaVersion 1 and tenantScoped true.
isolation: Separate processes and databases. No direct access to another component's database or storage directories.
